zh.title: 索馬利亞航空把重啟儀式訂在 12 月 10 日，定期航班日期待公布
zh.summary: 索馬利亞交通及民航部長表示，停飛約 35 年的國家航空公司預計 12 月 10 日舉行重啟儀式。
body: 索馬利亞交通及民航部長穆罕默德・法拉赫・努赫（Mohamed Farah Nuux）表示，索馬利亞航空準備在 12 月 10 日舉行重啟儀式。報導指出，定期客運何時開航、首批航點及班表仍待公布。
索馬利亞航空在 1991 年停止營運。據 Aerospace Global News 報導，原訂今年 9 月恢復商業航班的計畫未能如期實現。這次公告確定了儀式目標日期，旅客仍須等候航空公司公布實際航班。

en.title: Somali Airlines targets 10 December relaunch ceremony as flight dates remain pending
en.summary: Somalia’s transport and civil aviation minister says the national carrier plans a 10 December relaunch ceremony after about 35 years out of service.
body: Somali transport and civil aviation minister Mohamed Farah Nuux said Somali Airlines plans to hold its relaunch ceremony on 10 December. Reports say the start date for scheduled passenger flights, initial destinations and timetable are still pending.

The airline suspended operations in 1991. Aerospace Global News reported that an earlier target to resume commercial services in September 2026 passed without flights restarting. Passengers are still awaiting details of the airline’s first scheduled services.

facts.claim: The transport minister said a relaunch ceremony was planned for 10 December 2026.
Somali Airlines suspended operations in 1991, and a date for regular passenger flights has not been confirmed.
A previous September 2026 target passed without commercial operations resuming.
